title: Weisfeiler-Leman in the BAMBOO: Novel AMR Graph Metrics and a Benchmark for AMR Graph Similarity
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing and evaluating metrics for Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) graph similarity. It does not contain any component that evaluates or benchmarks religion, faith, morals, or ethics. A brief linguistic example mentioning 'priest' is used to illustrate a potential word-sense disambiguation error and does not constitute a substantive engagement with the topic.
